name: Oil shale retorting
principle: Oil shale is heated without oxygen to 450 to 500 °C so kerogen decomposes into oil, gas and residue. Only Kiviter, Galoter, Fushun and Petrosix remained in commercial use by 2006; Estonia produced 355,000 t of shale oil in 2008 and Brazil 200,000 t.
